_comment: Explicit KiCad library locations for tools/resolve_kicad_libs.py.
Resolution order is: KICAD{9,8,7}_SYMBOL_DIR/_FOOTPRINT_DIR env vars, then
this file, then per-platform defaults. If the paths below do not exist on
your machine the resolver falls through to the platform defaults, so this
file is safe to commit. Override it with $STAGE1_IV_KICAD_CONFIG.
Install a pinned library revision with: tools/install_kicad_libs.sh
